title: Welcome to MacroStiff
description:
In this course, you will learn C from scratch all the way to building your own garbage collector.
You are a developer at the totally-not-real company _MacroStiff_, working on their latest operating system:
**Bidirectional Interface Network Data Observation System 12 (BINDOS)**

Just make the code output _exactly_ "Welcome to BINDOS"
